title: Preparation of soluble and functional recombinant HTLV-1 Tax protein using bacterial chaperones.
authors: Miura, Michi; Murayama, Kazutaka; Uemura, Satoshi; Kitamura, Hiroshi; Saito, Mineki; Kanda, Teru
one_liner_zh: 该文利用细菌伴侣蛋白制备可溶性HTLV-1 Tax无序蛋白，并用AlphaFold2建模和分子热力学模拟预测其结构域，为后续无序蛋白与宿主蛋白互作的结构研究奠定基础，但未直接研究PPI机制。
abstract: HTLV-1 viral protein Tax physically interacts with multiple host proteins to disrupt their normal functions, causing debilitating haematological malignancy and inflammatory disorders. The recombinant Tax protein, like other intrinsically disordered proteins, is insoluble when expressed in Escherichia coli due to the inclusion body formation, hampering structural studies of this important viral protein. We report that the bacterial chaperone Trigger Factor significantly enhances the solubility of HTLV-1 Tax fused to maltose-binding protein (MBP) as a solubility tag. Using a hexahistidine tag in addition to MBP enabled a two-step purification to isolate Tax from the MBP moiety after cleaving the fusion protein with HRV 3C protease. The purified recombinant protein activated NF-kappaB, indicating that the recombinant protein, solubilised by Trigger Factor, was functional. A molecular thermodynamics simulation, using a 3D model generated by AlphaFold2 as the initial state, suggested two putative domains within the Tax protein. These predicted domains could also be expressed and purified in the presence of exogenous Trigger Factor. By enabling the production of full-length and predicted domains of HTLV-1 Tax in the soluble form, this study takes the first step towards structural studies to understand how HTLV-1 Tax mechanistically interacts with various host factors.
abstract_zh: HTLV-1病毒蛋白Tax与多种宿主蛋白发生物理相互作用，破坏其正常功能，导致严重的血液恶性肿瘤和炎症性疾病。重组Tax蛋白与其他固有无序蛋白一样，在大肠杆菌中表达时因包涵体形成而不可溶，阻碍了该重要病毒蛋白的结构研究。我们报道细菌伴侣蛋白Trigger Factor显著增强了与麦芽糖结合蛋白（MBP）作为溶解度标签融合的HTLV-1 Tax的溶解度。在MBP之外使用六组氨酸标签，使得在HRV 3C蛋白酶切割融合蛋白后，能够通过两步纯化从MBP部分分离Tax。纯化的重组蛋白激活了NF-kappaB，表明由Trigger Factor增溶的重组蛋白具有功能性。使用AlphaFold2生成的3D模型作为初始状态进行的分子热力学模拟，提示Tax蛋白内存在两个推定结构域。这些预测的结构域也能在外源Trigger Factor存在下表达和纯化。通过实现HTLV-1 Tax全长及预测结构域的可溶形式生产，本研究为理解HTLV-1 Tax如何与多种宿主因子机制性相互作用的结构研究迈出了第一步。
